recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied Jira intent by aligning the narrative definition with the already-applied conformance target list; no further core source change is indicated for FHIR-45470.
issue_request: FHIR-45470 was an Applied OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add direct Organization support to Specimen.collection.collector with Reference(Organization) and cardinality 0..1 so a collection facility does not need to be represented indirectly through PractitionerRole.organization.
initial_application: The Jira comment identified PR 3107/c06f3f2 as the build application. Git history shows the actual Specimen source change in 7326eeac4138092b833239ce9690713429808b77, which added the Organization targetProfile to source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml. Current source already retained Reference(Organization) and max 1 on Specimen.collection.collector, so the structural part of the applied resolution was present before this reconciliation.
additional_context: OO Confluence minutes first captured discussion about indirect collection-facility representation and then the May 2024 WGM motion to add Organization directly to Specimen.collection.collector, reference to organization, cardinality 0..1, with a 7-0-1 vote. source/fhir.ini lists Specimen as an active resource and work-group artifact. FHIR-32907 previously broadened the same collector element for patient-collected specimens, supporting generic actor wording rather than a person-only definition. No Zulip discussion was found that conflicted with the Jira, Confluence, or git evidence.
reconciliation: Updated source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml to define Specimen.collection.collector as the individual or organization that collected the specimen, and updated the checked-in source/specimen/specimen.svg tooltip that carried the same stale person-only definition. No cardinality or targetProfile edit was needed because Organization was already present.
source_changes: source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: changed Specimen.collection.collector definition from person-only wording to individual-or-organization wording.
source/specimen/specimen.svg: updated the collector tooltip to match the StructureDefinition definition.
